meaning: A message or alert from an app or phone that tells you something may need your attention.
clues: It is an alert that appears on your phone when something may need your attention.
An app or the phone itself sends it, usually not at a time you chose, and not as a call or note from a person.
It may show a message, sound, or vibration from an app even when you are doing something else.
You can find missed ones by swiping down or checking its history.
Its name starts with N and has twelve letters.
assumes: An alarm goes off at a time you choose
A phone call is a live talk with a person
A text message is written by a person and sent to you

decoys.meaning: A timed sound or alert that wakes you or reminds you about something.
A live talk with another person by phone.
A short written message sent from one phone to another.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Try it with someone you trust. Open your phone's settings, choose Notifications, and review which apps can alert you.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Our desk bell did one job. This little alert can remind you about many things, so it helps to set some limits.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: If an alert worries you, open the app yourself. Do not follow its link.

blank.sentence: The app buzzed my phone at a time I did not pick, with this ___ and not a note from a person.

why: Too many alerts get noisy, so you can limit which apps send them.
short: Alert from an app or phone

situations.text: An alert on your phone says there is a problem with an account and has a link. You tap the link.
situations.why: Open the app yourself. Do not follow the link.
